thread:
Ben: Ping — AeroGrid sent the final solution brief + logo pack. Need quick decisions: logo lockup, alt text, and marketplace tile sizes. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/AeroGrid-Redwood-coasset
Sofia: Thanks — downloading. Do we have SVGs or only PNGs? I need vector for lockups.
Ben: SVGs included in the zip (assets > logos > svg). Also a dark-mode version.
Sofia: Cool. Quick question on lockup: AeroGrid requested their logo on the left of our mark separated by 24px. Legal OK with that? @Mike
Mike: Skimmed their brand guidelines. They allow left lockups for co-branded solution briefs but require 40px clearspace around their mark and no tinting of the logo. Also: they require alt text for all marketplace tiles that mentions their name.
Raj: For the marketplace tile copy — do we have an approved 1-line hero? I was leaning toward: "AeroGrid + Redwood: Low-latency inference at scale" — thoughts?
Olivia: That works. Can we add a subline: "Dedicated GPU pools + regional routing"? Keep it short for the tile.
Sofia: I'll build both 1:1 and 3:2 tiles. What sizes do we need exactly? Marketplace wants 1024x1024 (square), 1200x628 (card). Confirmed?
design-bot: Recommended alt text options (please pick one):
```
1) "AeroGrid and Redwood logos side-by-side with the title 'Low-latency inference at scale'"
2) "Redwood and AeroGrid co-branded solution: dedicated GPU pools and regional routing"
3) "Co-marketing tile: AeroGrid + Redwood — low-latency model inference"
```
Sofia: I'll use option 2 as the default but will keep 1 and 3 for accessibility testing. Also posting a quick CSS-safe color swatch for the tile: `#0B63FF` (redwood blue on light overlay) + AeroGrid gradient.
Mike: Confirming legal okay with option 2. Also flag: do not include any customer PII or logos other than AeroGrid and Redwood.
Raj: Can someone add a brief customer quote placeholder we can swap later? "We reduced latency by 4x on critical workloads" — placeholder tag: [QUOTE_PLACEHOLDER].
Sofia: Noted. I'll export tiles and a one-page hero image and upload to the assets folder by EOD tomorrow. Need final +1s before publishing to the marketplace.
Ben: Timeline sounds good. @Raj @Mike please post final copy + legal OK by noon tomorrow so Sofia can ship. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Olivia: Quick technical check — brief mentions the new KV cache tuning from Redwood v1.8, that's accurate, yes.
Ben: Perfect. I'll follow up with AeroGrid on a 24-hour approval window.
Sofia: Will do.
